run.method: pivot star; banded monotonic DP over unit vectors (vecalign-style beads up to 4:1, baseline-corrected cosine), mutual-nearest-neighbour anchors, re-alignment of unaligned blocks

text.method: same-language editions aligned with the head of their language (the pivot if it is one) by their folded words (patience-style anchors, difflib in small gaps, runs of 3+ words), carried through the head's beads; their text beads replace vector beads and keep their pivot units in one group
